body.x: Midland Radio(http://www.midlandradio.com), headquartered in Kansas City, MO, is the U.S. affiliate of an international group of companies with offices in North America, Europe and Asia.

Since 1959, Midland has been at the forefront of two-way radio technology, offering products with the latest features at value prices. Midland is the oldest manufacturer of CB radios in the U.S., and a leading supplier of consumer weather / all-hazards alert radios in the U.S. Our consumer products are sold by leading electronics and sporting goods retailers nationwide and by a wide range of internet retailers.
Midland's Professional Radio Division is a leading supplier of 2-way communications products to Federal, state and local government agencies as well as private commercial enterprises.
Meanwhile 2012 International CES 2012 will be held at Las Vegas, US, from Jan 10 to 13.
